data.gender_notes: Medhavi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Medhavi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘medha’, meaning ‘intelligence’ or ‘wisdom’. It is believed to be a sacred name that bestows the blessings of knowledge and wisdom upon the bearer. In Hindu mythology, Medhavi is the name of a sage who was known for his immense wisdom and knowledge. The name Medhavi carries the meaning “Intellect, Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Medhavi usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
